members.name: routing_v0
members.instructions: A customer of a digital bank sent this message to the support chat. Which specific issue is the customer asking about?

criteria.card_payment_not_recognised: A payment, debit or transaction on the statement that the customer did not make, does not recognise or finds mysterious
criteria.cash_withdrawal_not_recognised: A cash/ATM withdrawal that the customer did not make or does not recognise, or a withdrawal shown in the app for cash they never took out (e.g. 'I see non-received cash in my app')
criteria.direct_debit_not_recognised: A direct debit the customer does not recognise, did not authorise, or wants refunded or reversed
criteria.compromised_card: Customer thinks their card details were stolen, someone else is using the card, or the card is compromised
criteria.lost_or_stolen_card: The card was lost or stolen, including questions about fees, charges or consequences after a card was lost or stolen
criteria.lost_or_stolen_phone: The phone with the app was lost, stolen or left somewhere (e.g. at a hotel); using the app or account without the phone
criteria.passcode_forgotten: Forgot app passcode / password, locked out of the app
criteria.pin_blocked: The card or PIN is blocked or locked, or the customer has lost access to their card
criteria.request_refund: Wants a refund for a purchase, wants to cancel a purchase they made, or asks how to dispute a purchase
criteria.refund_not_showing: A refund from a merchant has not appeared in the account yet
criteria.charged_twice: The same transaction charged twice, duplicated or showing several times, including a declined payment that still shows charges
criteria.reverted_card_payment: A payment the customer made shows as cancelled, terminated or reverted, has disappeared or can't be found in the app, or the money came back
criteria.wrong_cash_amount: The ATM gave less cash than requested or than was debited, or the customer did not get the cash they wanted or has not received their cash yet
criteria.extra_charge_on_statement: An extra charge or fee (often a small amount such as 1 pound or 1 dollar) on the statement that the customer cannot explain
criteria.card_arrival: The ordered card has not arrived yet / tracking a card
criteria.card_delivery_estimate: How long card delivery takes, or whether a card can be delivered to a given country
criteria.card_not_working: The card is not working / not accepted
criteria.card_swallowed: An ATM swallowed, kept or took the customer's card
criteria.card_about_to_expire: Card expiring, how to renew/replace an expiring card
criteria.card_linking: Linking a card to the app or account, or using again a card the customer found after reporting it lost
criteria.disposable_card_limits: How many times disposable cards can be used / their limits
criteria.virtual_card_not_working: Virtual or disposable card not working
criteria.spare_card: Getting additional / spare cards, cards for family
criteria.change_pin: Changing or getting the card PIN
criteria.apple_google_pay: Any question that mentions Apple Pay, Google Pay or an Apple Watch (including topping up or adding funds through them, or which currencies or cards they accept)
criteria.visa_or_mastercard: Visa vs Mastercard: whether the bank's card is a Visa or a Mastercard, whether the customer can choose which card they get, or can get or use a Visa or Mastercard
criteria.pending_card_payment: A card payment is still pending or has not gone through yet
criteria.pending_cash_withdrawal: A cash withdrawal is still pending or taking a long time to go through, or the balance does not yet reflect cash the customer withdrew
criteria.declined_cash_withdrawal: A cash withdrawal at the ATM was declined or the ATM would not give cash
criteria.declined_transfer: A transfer was declined, or the customer complains their transfers keep being denied or declined
criteria.cancel_transfer: Cancel / reverse a transfer or payment already made
criteria.transfer_not_received: Recipient has not received the transfer
criteria.transfer_into_account: How to transfer money into the account / bank details for incoming transfers
criteria.receiving_money: How to receive money, get a salary paid in, or get paid by others (not about fees)
criteria.balance_not_updated_transfer: Balance not updated after a bank transfer, or money the customer expected in their balance is missing or has disappeared
criteria.balance_not_updated_deposit: Balance not updated after cheque or cash deposit
criteria.top_up_methods: How to top up the account, top up by card, cash or cheque
criteria.verify_top_up: Verifying a top-up or the card used to top up, the top-up verification code
criteria.top_up_limits: Limits on how much money can be topped up, added or spent per day or in total (top-up limits, daily limit on the card)
criteria.transaction_receipt: Wants a receipt, statement or proof for a transfer or money transaction they made
criteria.direct_debit_setup: Setting up direct debits or standing orders, paying bills
criteria.card_payment_fee: A fee charged on a card payment, purchase or transaction the customer made (including unexpected fees on purchases abroad or in another currency), or why payments have fees
criteria.transfer_fee: A fee charged for sending or receiving a transfer or money, including whether the full amount of a transfer (e.g. SEPA) will arrive without deductions
criteria.top_up_by_card_charge: A fee for topping up by card
criteria.top_up_by_transfer_charge: A fee for topping up by bank transfer
criteria.exchange_rate: General question about which exchange rate the bank uses or how rates are set (not about a rate on a specific transaction)
criteria.wrong_exchange_rate_card: Complaint or doubt that the exchange rate applied to a payment or purchase was wrong, too high, or different from what the customer expected
criteria.wrong_exchange_rate_cash: Complaint that a wrong exchange rate or amount was applied to a cash withdrawal abroad
criteria.fiat_currency_support: Which currencies can be held / exchanged
criteria.supported_cards_and_currencies: Whether a specific other card type the customer names (e.g. American Express, a credit card) is accepted or can be used, even to add money; which currencies are supported
criteria.verify_identity: How to verify identity, documents needed
criteria.verify_source_of_funds: Source of funds: proving where money comes from, or the customer asking where money in their account came from or who is giving it to them
criteria.edit_personal_details: Changing name, address or personal details
criteria.age_limit: Minimum age to open an account
criteria.country_support: Which countries are supported, where the service can be used, or whether people living outside the UK (e.g. in America) are eligible for an account or a card
criteria.crypto: Anything involving cryptocurrency: buying or holding crypto, crypto top-ups, or sending money to a crypto exchange
criteria.account_safety: How the bank keeps customers' money safe, deposit protection, security of the service in general
criteria.get_account: Opening an account, other account questions
